title: Teitelboim and Oron (2016): Attributed band alignment and alternative UC mechanisms

productFacts.label: Band alignment
productFacts.value: Relatively flat PbSe/CdSe conduction band permits electron delocalization; deep PbSe valence band and CdSe(ZB)/CdSe(WZ) energetic regions provide a double-well picture for hot holes.

productFacts.label: Auger-mediated possibility
productFacts.value: Sequential interband absorption forms a biexciton, followed by Auger recombination that generates a hot hole.

productFacts.label: Intraband possibility
productFacts.value: Interband excitation followed by intraband absorption of the hole can generate a hot hole.

productFacts.label: Mechanism discrimination
productFacts.value: Observed deviation from quadratic absorption dependence is insufficient to exclude either mechanism; authors suggest both can contribute.

productFacts.label: Visible emission interpretation
productFacts.value: Hot holes can transfer into the CdSe(WZ) well and recombine radiatively, as depicted by the authors.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
